defect: create_experiment_manifest emitted pair_valid=True / PAIRED_INGOLSTADT_CAPTURE although the strict downstream validator rejected the pair because required arm-level identities were missing and no capture-completion evidence existed.
remediation: Strict multi-stage builder: (1) MAP_PAIR_ELIGIBLE evaluated independently; (2) identity completeness on BOTH arms for all REQUIRED_ARM_IDENTITY_KEYS; (3) cross-arm equality + top-level binding; (4) route bound to verified artifact (synthesized /reference/ fallback rejected); (5) capture-completion receipt, dataset content sha, terminal status; (6) accepted pairing keys; (7) strict validate_pair_manifest(); (8) claim promoted ONLY when validator valid AND all evidence present.
root_cause: Builder validated ONLY the map pair (validate_ingolstadt_pair) then constructed manual_arm/auto_arm dicts containing map identity only, with no REQUIRED_ARM_IDENTITY_KEYS.
